query: I am evaluating a 51‑year‑old woman. Among female Medicare patients aged 46–56 who were transferred from another hospital with a principal diagnosis of hip fracture, how many index admissions meet these cohort criteria in this MIMIC‑IV hospital dataset?
final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS index_admissions_count
FROM physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions a
JOIN physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
JOIN physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd d ON a.hadm_id = d.hadm_id
JOIN physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.d_icd_diagnoses dd ON d.icd_code = dd.icd_code AND d.icd_version = dd.icd_version
WHERE p.gender = 'F'
  AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 46 AND 56
  AND a.insurance = 'Medicare'
  AND a.admission_location = 'TRANSFER FROM OTHER HOSP'
  AND d.seq_num = 1
  AND LOWER(dd.long_title) LIKE '%hip fracture%';
